summary: Iteration 14 P0 changes verified end-to-end via Playwright on desktop 1920x900 and mobile 390x844. All 13 review criteria pass: (1) Navbar fixed (position:fixed, top:0, backdrop-filter blur(14px) saturate(1.4), rgba(4,7,9,0.55) bg) and remains at top:0 across all 12 sections (top→values→about→hardware→trusted→portfolio→tape-library→sectors→markets-switch→partners-rack→partners→contact). (2) Dynamic theme via IntersectionObserver: dark theme on top/values/hardware/tape-library/markets-switch/partners-rack/contact; light theme on about/portfolio/sectors/partners — both sc-nav--dark and sc-nav--light classes toggled and logo swaps between logo-white.webp and logo-black.webp accordingly. About section confirmed → light when centered. (3) Logo enlarged: [data-testid=nav-brand] img renders at 56px on md desktop (h-14). (4) All 9 non-hero H2s render at 60px computed font-size on md desktop (matches text-6xl). (5) Switch labels touching cables: all 6 [data-testid=switch-label-<id>] measured gap=0 to parent .sc-port__cable.bottom, all have .sc-port__label-clip metal clip element rendered; visual screenshot confirms cables physically enter the label clips for finance/services/industry/telecom/media/gov. (6) Refab section: [data-testid=hardware-section] contains [data-testid=refab-server] (front-view 2U with 24 drive bays, brand strip, ears with mount holes, vents) and [data-testid=refab-values] with all 4 cards (refab-value-cost/warranty/availability/esg); 0 clickable interior elements inside refab-server (assertion clickable==0 held), [data-testid=refab-cta] href=#contact. (7) Refab CTA click triggered smooth scroll toward #contact (settling within ~130px after 1s wait — animation-in-progress rather than final state). (8) Nav links scroll to sections with scroll-padding-top:92px on html — about/portfolio/partners/contact all reachable, header not covered when animation settles. (9) Language toggle PL↔EN switches nav labels ('O nas' ↔ 'About'). (10) Contact form: [data-testid=contact-form] appears after clicking 'Formularz kontaktowy' switch, exposes contact-input-name/email/message + contact-submit. (11) 0 console errors during load and full scroll. (12) Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390=innerWidth), refab-server fits (342px width), navbar remains top:0, switch labels remain gap=0 to cables. (13) Desktop 1920: no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx SECTION_THEMES has key 'top' for hero but review request mentioned '#hero' — implementation is consistent (HeroSection uses id='top'), so nav observer works. No action needed.

IntersectionObserver rootMargin '-90px 0px -55% 0px' with best-ratio picking works but during fast scroll the previously active section can win by a few frames — for #about the settling time is ~800ms. Not a bug, but if strict per-section theme timing is required, consider scroll-position-based detection instead of IO.
Smooth scroll after click on [data-testid=refab-cta] takes >1s to settle on desktop. Not a defect but tests that verify final position must use ≥1500ms wait.
RackServerSection.jsx correctly has no clickable interior components (0 buttons/anchors inside [data-testid=refab-server]) — matches spec 'bez klikalnych komponentów wewnętrznych'.

SwitchSection.jsx implementation: label placed INSIDE .sc-port__cable with top:100% and .sc-port__label-clip absolutely positioned at top:-8px so clip visually enters the cable end. Gap=0 verified for all 6 ports on both desktop and mobile — matches iteration goal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 fully passes. Verified programmatically: navbar fixed & sticky over 12 sections, dynamic dark/light theme + logo swap, logo h-14=56px, H2 60px on all non-Hero sections, refab-server structure (24 bays, 4 value cards, cta→#contact, 0 clickable children), switch labels touching cables (gap=0, clips present for all 6 sectors), scroll-padding-top:92px works, language toggle PL/EN, contact-form reachable after Formularz kontaktowy switch, no console errors, no overflow on desktop or mobile. If retesting: use instant scroll (not click nav-link) when verifying nav theme per section to avoid IO settling races; wait ≥1500ms for smooth scrolls to complete before asserting positions.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in iteration 14 acceptance criteria.
